hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v playpilot >/dev/null 2>&1 || for c in cargo /root/.cargo/bin/cargo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo"; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$c" install --locked --quiet --git https://github.com/modootoday/playpilot --rev 4ed7daee4b5bfa4a3b0a89e7f5e2281690efec48 playpilot >&2 && break; done; command -v playpilot >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$HOME/.cargo/bin/playpilot" ] || { echo "playpilot CLI is missing and could not be installed" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$(command -v playpilot || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/playpilot")" guard'
